answer: One workable design: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because juniper only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, falcon is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any forge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
